title: filago heterantha subsp. cupaniana
intro: Filago heterantha subsp. cupaniana, commonly known as Cupani's fleabane, is a plant species belonging to the family Asteraceae. Cupani's fleabane is valued for its medicinal properties, which include treating various health issues such as fever, inflammation, and respiratory problems, due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which help in soothing and calming the body. The bioactive constituents present in Cupani's fleabane include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal effects.
